skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Frosted Steps
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Frosted Steps. Outfit Matoimaru wore when taking part in a period piece. An elegant Higashinese dress combined with delicate makeup bring out her hidden charms in all their glory.
skins.quote: 'She walked down the towering steps, one by one, like a goddess descending from the mountains.' Everyone was stunned into silence by Matoimaru's performance. They could not help but wonder: Is she an acting genius? Or is she actually—
